work._default: Name one judgment call you own this quarter. Write the decision rule so someone else could apply it.

w1_role.between_roles: Treat this quarter as a position rebuild: one owned artifact and three vouchers before chasing volume applications.
w1_role.not_earning: Pick one paid or owned surface this month — even tiny — so the Work sheet has a fact to update.
w1_role.studying: Attach one real judgment artifact to your training this term — something a hiring manager can review.
w1_role.employee_contractor: Find one piece of work you can own end-to-end this quarter, not just contribute to.
w1_role.freelancer_solo: Replace one hour-sold engagement with a named offer or asset that outlives the invoice.
w1_role.founder_equity: Protect founder judgment time: cut one recurring first-pass task you still do yourself.

w2_task_surface.most_gte_75: Cut one recurring first-pass task this month; replace the hours with a judgment artifact someone else must review.
w2_task_surface.about_half: Shift one half-day a week from first-pass production to a reviewable decision or owned draft.
w2_task_surface.minority_lte_25: Document the judgment work you already do so it is visible — one case write-up this month.
w2_task_surface.almost_none_judgment: Keep the judgment surface; teach one junior or peer the decision rule you use.
w2_task_surface.unknown: Time-log one typical week by task type. You cannot cut exposure you cannot see.

w3_senior_review.nearly_everything: Ask for one piece this month that ships without senior rewrite — owned end-to-end.
w3_senior_review.important_pieces: Propose the review criteria yourself once; own the standard, not only the draft.
w3_senior_review.rarely: Invite one deliberate review on a hard call — practice being trusted, not only unsupervised.
w3_senior_review.nothing_last_stop: Write down your decision rule for the hardest call you own; make it teachable.
w3_senior_review.na: Name who would review a hard call if you needed one — even outside your current role.

w4_ownership.no: Ship one owned asset this quarter — a named tool, note, or audience — even if tiny.
w4_ownership.unsure: List what would still be yours if you left tomorrow. If the list is empty, start one asset this month.
w4_ownership.small_symbolic: Grow the small asset into something material: one public or client-facing version this quarter.
w4_ownership.yes_material: Protect the owned asset with a weekly maintenance block; do not let first-pass work crowd it out.

w5_trust_vouch.none: Earn one voucher this quarter: ask someone who has seen your judgment for a hard-call referral.
w5_trust_vouch.one_or_two: Deepen the thin circle — one 30-minute debrief with each after a real decision this month.
w5_trust_vouch.small_circle_3_5: Use the circle: run one hard decision past them before you commit.
w5_trust_vouch.wider_set: Convert trust into ownership — one stake, book, or named responsibility this quarter.

capital._default: Write a one-page cash position this week: runway months, fixed costs, and what you will not risk until the floor is clear.

c3_runway.lt_1: Build a written 90-day cash floor before any new risk. Track weekly.
c3_runway.m1_3: Write a 90-day cash floor this week. Track actual burn every Sunday. No new financial risk until you can see the floor.
c3_runway.m3_6: Extend the floor toward six months: name one expense cut or income action this month.
c3_runway.m6_12: Keep the floor; automate one payday transfer into a boring compounding vehicle you already qualify for.
c3_runway.gt_12: Document the floor; decide one structural upgrade (wrapper or compounding) you can name without product shopping.
c3_runway.unknown: Calculate runway in hours this weekend from cash you would actually use. Unknown is not neutral.

c4_savings_rate.negative: Stop the bleed first: one written spending cap for thirty days before any investment talk.
c4_savings_rate.none: Start a fixed payday transfer — even small — into cash reserve until runway is visible.
c4_savings_rate.under_10: Raise the keep-rate by one clear cut or raise this quarter; track it monthly.
c4_savings_rate.p10_20: Keep the habit; route the surplus to one compounding vehicle you already understand.
c4_savings_rate.over_20: Protect the rate; name where the surplus sits so it compounds by design.
c4_savings_rate.irregular: Replace irregularity with one fixed transfer for the next eight weeks; adjust after.

c5_debt.distressed: Name the full debt stack on one page this week. Get one human with scars on the call before new risk.
c5_debt.heavy: List payments that constrain choices; pick one to renegotiate or accelerate this quarter.
c5_debt.manageable: Keep payments current; do not add consumer debt while building the cash floor.
c5_debt.none_worry: Leave debt alone; put attention on runway and compounding structure.
c5_debt.prefer_not: If you can, write the debt picture privately this week — structure needs a fact, not a mood.

c6_compounds_wrappers.neither: Open one boring compounding vehicle you already qualify for; fund it on payday once. Educational — not a product push.
c6_compounds_wrappers.unknown: Learn the wrapper names for your residence pack this week. Glossary only — no product to buy yet.
c6_compounds_wrappers.wrappers_only: Put something that compounds by design inside a wrapper you already have — once, on payday.
c6_compounds_wrappers.compounds_only: Name one tax wrapper you already qualify for; confirm whether you use it. Education, not advice.
c6_compounds_wrappers.both: Keep funding on payday; review the structure once this quarter, not the price chatter daily.

body._default: Pick one body constraint — sleep window or two training sessions — and hold it for fourteen days before adding goals.

b1_sleep_hours.under_6: Fix a sleep window for fourteen nights (±30 minutes) before changing training. Protect the hours first.
b1_sleep_hours.h6_7: Add thirty minutes to the sleep window for fourteen nights; hold bedtime ±30 minutes.
b1_sleep_hours.h7_8: Keep the hours; lock consistency next — same window ±30 minutes for fourteen nights.
b1_sleep_hours.over_8: Keep the hours; check consistency and hard-day capacity before adding load.
b1_sleep_hours.inconsistent: Pick a sleep window and hold it for fourteen nights (±30 minutes). Do not add training goals until that sticks.

b2_sleep_consistency.d0_1: Pick a sleep window and hold it for fourteen nights (±30 minutes). Do not add training goals until that sticks.
b2_sleep_consistency.d2_3: Raise stable nights to at least four this fortnight — same bedtime ±30 minutes.
b2_sleep_consistency.d4_5: Push toward six stable nights; protect the window on the two weak nights.
b2_sleep_consistency.d6_7: Maintain the window; put the next Body move on training or hard-day capacity.

b3_training_days.d0: Two training sessions per week, scheduled like meetings, for the next eight weeks.
b3_training_days.d1_2: Hold two sessions as non-negotiable; add a third only after four clean weeks.
b3_training_days.d3_4: Keep the cadence; protect sleep so training does not steal recovery.
b3_training_days.d5_plus: Audit recovery: if hard-day capacity is low, cut volume before cutting sleep.

b4a_hard_day_capacity.rarely: Treat capacity as the constraint: fourteen nights of sleep window before any new ambition.
b4a_hard_day_capacity.some_weeks: Stabilize sleep and two training days; reassess hard-day capacity in three weeks.
b4a_hard_day_capacity.most_days: Keep the base; do not trade sleep for more output this quarter.
b4a_hard_day_capacity.nearly_always: Maintain; put Body attention on the weaker sleep or training signal if any.

b4b_alcohol_dull_evenings.d5_plus: Cut dulling evenings to two or fewer for twenty-one days. Protect the next morning.
b4b_alcohol_dull_evenings.d3_4: Cut dulling evenings by half for twenty-one days. Protect the next morning.
b4b_alcohol_dull_evenings.d1_2: Keep dulling evenings rare; never stack them before a hard day you care about.
b4b_alcohol_dull_evenings.d0: Keep it. Put Body attention on sleep or training instead.
b4b_alcohol_dull_evenings.prefer_not: If alcohol is dulling mornings, cut those evenings for twenty-one days — privately, without theatre.

mind._default: Protect one forty-five-minute attention block daily for twenty-one days, and name the direction in one sentence.

m1_attention_block.under_20m: One protected 45-minute block daily, phone out of the room. Non-negotiable for 21 days.
m1_attention_block.none_protected: One protected 45-minute block daily, phone out of the room. Non-negotiable for 21 days.
m1_attention_block.m20_45: Extend the protected block to forty-five minutes daily for twenty-one days.
m1_attention_block.m45_90: Defend the block; put the next Mind move on direction or decision partners.
m1_attention_block.over_90m: Keep the deep block; use one session this week to write your two-to-three-year direction in one sentence.

m2_direction.none_reactive: Write one sentence for the next two-to-three years. Put it where you see it every Monday.
m2_direction.competing: Pick one primary direction for this quarter; park the others on a dated list.
m2_direction.rough: Sharpen the fog into one sentence someone else would recognise — this week.
m2_direction.clear: Keep the sentence visible; check weekly whether this week’s work serves it.

m3_decision_partners.nobody: Name one person with more scars than you; ask for one 30-minute call this month before your next hard decision.
m3_decision_partners.partner_family: Add one peer or senior outside the household for the next hard call this month.
m3_decision_partners.peers: Keep the peers; add one person with more scars for a single hard decision this quarter.
m3_decision_partners.one_senior: Use them before the next hard call — schedule the conversation, do not wait for crisis.
m3_decision_partners.circle: Run one real decision through the circle this month; write what you learned.

m4_story_strain.system_pointless: Replace the dead-end story with one next useful move on paper each Monday for four weeks.
m4_story_strain.i_am_the_problem: When the bad month hits, write three facts and one next move before the self-verdict.
m4_story_strain.unstable: Adopt one default line: this is weather — keep the next useful move. Use it for thirty days.
m4_story_strain.weather_next_move: Keep the weather story; pair it with a named decision partner for hard calls.
